project.title: M_H_Q.SYS: Dual-Persona Interactive Portfolio
project.technology: React 19 | Vite | Tailwind CSS v4 | Framer Motion |
project.description: An interactive portfolio website themed around a dual-persona system. Visitors switch between two modes: a Full Stack Developer view (Cobalt Cyan) and a Data Analyst view (Crimson Red). Each mode has its own color theme, copy, skills and project descriptions. It includes an in-browser terminal CLI, a live system telemetry HUD, a skills radar chart, a project detail modal, a background music jukebox, and an animated mascot companion.

project.title: Market Pulse (In Development).
project.description: An interactive cryptocurrency analytics dashboard featuring historical market data integration and experimental price forecasting using Auto-ARIMA. Built to explore time-series analysis and full-stack application development in highly volatile financial markets.
